subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30min intro demo — stakeholder options
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30min intro demo — stakeholder options

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciated the clear signal on priorities and the deployment constraints you mentioned. Quick recap:
- Goal: evaluate whether Redwood can replace your prototype inference stack and reduce token cost with similar latency.
- Key constraints: VPC-only deployment for PHI, 4–6ms median token latency target for short prompts, and procurement timeline by end of Q3.

Next step: 30-minute product intro + Q&A (we'll demo latency/cost, routing, and deployment options). Two time windows that work for our team (Pacific):

Option A — Tue May 18, 10:00–10:30 AM PT (13:00–13:30 ET)
Option B — Wed May 19, 2:00–2:30 PM PT (17:00–17:30 ET)

Please let us know which you prefer and who from NovaCare should attend (CTO, Product Lead, Security/Procurement?). I've attached a short one-pager (Redwood-Intro-1pager.pdf) and a lightweight MVP checklist (MVP-onepager.pdf) to help stakeholders prep.

If neither window works, tell us two 30-minute windows that do and we'll prioritize matching availability.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0192
From: Emily Wu <emily.wu@novacare.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrew Li <andrew.li@novacare.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30min intro demo — stakeholder options

Hi Dylan — thanks for the recap and materials.

Option B (Wed May 19, 2:00–2:30 PM PT) works best for our core group. Tentative attendees:
- Andrew Li (CTO)
- Sana Patel (Product)
- procurement@novacare.com (small procurement/IT representative)

Quick Q: would you recommend inviting Security now or should we run the product intro first and have a follow-up with Security later? Andrew prefers keeping security briefed but not necessarily in the first 30m.

I'll confirm final attendee list by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Emily Wu
Head of AI Strategy
NovaCare Solutions
(312) 555-0128
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30min intro demo — stakeholder options

Emily — great, thanks. Wed May 19, 2:00–2:30 PM PT is penciled.

Recommendation: keep Security off the first session to keep it focused on product fit; we'll capture any security-specific asks and schedule a deeper 45–60m follow-up with our Security/Compliance lead as needed. If NovaCare prefers Security present, we can extend to 45 minutes.

Tessa (cc) will run the demo and cover the deployment matrix and a brief latency/cost run-through. We'll send a calendar invite once attendees are confirmed by your team.

Action items:
- Emily: confirm final attendee list (Andrew + Sana + procurement?)
- Tessa: prepare a 12–15 minute demo + 10 minute Q&A covering VPC/on-prem options, routing, and auto-fallbacks

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Dylan
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@novacare.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo invite + quick prep

Hi Emily — sending the invite for Wed May 19, 2:00–2:30 PM PT (redwood-demo.ics attached).

Quick prep notes for attendees:
- We'll demo: hosted API + Dedicated routing, sample latency numbers on comparable hardware, and the deployment abstraction for private VPCs.
- Please have one engineer available (prod or infra) if you want a short integration Q&A.
- If you decide to include Security, flag that and we can add 15 minutes or schedule a follow-up.

See you Wed — attaching the calendar (.ics) and the two one-pagers again.

Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
